content: प्रस्तावना .²1 Causing to be praised or mentioned, praising, praise. .²2 Beginning, commencement; आर्य बालचरितप्रस्तावनाडिण्डिमः <ls>Mv. 1. 54</ls>. .²3 An introduction, preface, exordium (in general); प्रस्तावना इयं कपटनाटकस्य <ls>Māl. 2</ls>. .²4 Sounding forth. .²5 An introductory dialogue (the prologue) at the beginning of a drama between the manager and one of the actors, which, after giving an account of the author and his qualifications <ab>&c.</ab>, introduces the audience to the incidents of the drama; (for definition, see आमुख).
